description: Urban Development Authority - Approval of the Development Plan for Limit of  Ampara Urban Council and Part of Pradeshiya Sabha Limits of Namal oya.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land development and urban planning matters. It specifically concerns the approval of a development plan for the limits of Ampara Urban Council and part of Namal Oya Pradeshiya Sabha. The content focuses on land use planning and development regulations under the Urban Development Authority Law, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land use planning and zoning changes. While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the core land-related administrative action being taken.
